title: New in Symfony 8.2: OpenID Connect Login
content:
<html><head></head><body>OpenID Connect (OIDC) is the protocol behind most "Log in with ..." buttons.
It lets your application delegate user authentication to an identity provider
such as Keycloak, Authentik, Auth0, Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.
Symfony 6.3 added OIDC token handlers…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
